import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def max_pretty_set_length(n, s):
    max_length = 0
    current_set = set()
    
    for char in s:
        if char.islower():
            current_set.add(char)
        else:
            max_length = max(max_length, len(current_set))
            current_set.clear()
    
    max_length = max(max_length, len(current_set))
    return max_length

data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
s = data[1]

result = max_pretty_set_length(n, s)
print(result)
T_solution:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
s = data[1]

max_pretty_set = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i, n):
        pretty_set = set()
        is_valid = True
        for k in range(i, j + 1):
            if s[k].isupper():
                is_valid = False
                break
            pretty_set.add(s[k])
        if is_valid:
            max_pretty_set = max(max_pretty_set, len(pretty_set))

print(max_pretty_set)
